8-Day Black Sea Turkey Tour: Trabzon, Rize & Ayder
summary:
The 8-Day Istanbul, Trabzon, Rize, Ayder & Uzungol Tour pairs Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine heritage with a journey through Turkey’s greener Black Sea region. After exploring the historic heart of Istanbul, fly to Trabzon and continue through Rize’s tea-growing countryside, the mountain setting of Ayder Plateau and the forested shores surrounding Uzungol. It is a particularly good choice for travelers who want to see a less familiar side of Turkey beyond the usual classical routes.
The itinerary can be arranged around your preferred dates, with selected 4-star hotels and breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and scheduled sightseeing included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Trabzon & Sumela Monastery & Karaca Cave Tour
itinerary.text:
Early morning transfer to the airport for your flight from Istanbul to Trabzon
Visit Sumela Monastery
Explore Altındere National Park
Drive through Zigana Pass with scenic mountain views
Visit Karaca Cave
Return to Trabzon and check in to hotel
Overnight in Trabzon

itinerary.title: Trabzon City Tour & Uzungöl
itinerary.text:
Explore the highlights of Trabzon.
Visit Hagia Sophia of Trabzon and admire its Byzantine frescoes.
Continue to Ataturk Mansion with views of the Black Sea.
See Trabzon Castle and stop at Sera Lake.
Enjoy lunch in Akcaabat, famous for its local meatballs.
Later, drive to Uzungöl. Walk around the lake and enjoy the mountain scenery.
Return to Trabzon and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Rize, Camlıhemşin & Ayder Plateau
itinerary.text:
Depart from Uzungol and drive to Rize.
Enjoy panoramic views from the Botanical Garden. Visit local tea and kiwi plantations.
Continue through Fırtına Valley toward Ayder Plateau.
Stop in Camlıhemşin and walk to Goksu Waterfall.
Arrive in Ayder before sunset.
Check in to your mountain hotel.
Dinner and overnight in Ayder.

itinerary.title: Ayder, Fındıklı & Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Explore Ayder Plateau and enjoy its waterfalls, thermal springs, and mountain views.
See traditional village life and local wooden houses.
Drive to Ortan Village along the Fırtına River.
Continue to Caglayan Valley in Fındıklı. Visit tea plantations and traditional Laz houses.
Transfer to Trabzon Airport for your flight to Istanbul.
Arrival transfer to hotel and overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Spice Market & Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.text:
Visit the historic Spice Bazaar, famous for spices, sweets, and local products.
Enjoy a scenic cruise on the Bosphorus Strait between Europe and Asia.
See waterfront palaces, mosques, and Ottoman mansions along the Bosphorus.
After the tour, transfer back to your hotel.
Rest of the day is free at leisure.
Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What is the 8-Day Black Sea Turkey tour and where does it go?
faqs.a: This 8-day scenic tour takes you from Istanbul to Turkey's lush Black Sea region. You see Istanbul's landmarks such as Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace, explore Trabzon, discover Rize's green tea plantations, relax at the Ayder Plateau, and enjoy the lake and mountain views of Uzungol. The trip runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Black Sea tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 1,645 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided tours, entrance fees, and transfers. The exact cost depends on your dates, hotel category, and group size.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the Black Sea Turkey tour?
faqs.a: Yes, two domestic flights are included to connect Istanbul with the Black Sea region efficiently. The itinerary includes a flight to Trabzon, which shortens the journey and gives you more time to enjoy the plateaus, monasteries, and mountain scenery.

faqs.q: What are the main highlights of this Black Sea itinerary?
faqs.a: Highlights include Istanbul's historic landmarks, the Sumela Monastery and Karaca Cave near Trabzon, the alpine lake of Uzungol, the tea-covered hills of Rize, and the natural beauty and hot springs of the Ayder Plateau. It is a tour built around dramatic green landscapes and mountain culture.

faqs.q: Is the Black Sea tour suitable for nature lovers?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for nature lovers. It focuses on Turkey's greenest region, with plateaus, waterfalls, tea gardens, forests, and mountain villages. If you prefer scenery and fresh air over crowded coastal resorts, the Black Sea itinerary is a perfect fit.

faqs.q: How physically demanding is this tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. There is walking on hilly terrain and some uneven paths at sites like the Sumela Monastery and the highland plateaus. Travelers in reasonable health should manage well, and the scenic drives provide plenty of rest between activities.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation is provided on the Black Sea tour?
faqs.a: The package includes hotel accommodation across the 7 nights with breakfast, along with guided tours and all transfers. Hotels are chosen for comfort and good access to the region's main attractions.

faqs.q: When is the best season for the Black Sea region tour?
faqs.a: The tour runs all year round, but late spring through early autumn is especially beautiful when the plateaus are green and the weather is mild. The Ayder and Uzungol highlands are at their most scenic in the warmer months, while each season offers its own atmosphere.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-day Black Sea tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is offered up to 30 days before the tour date. Cancellations within that window follow the trip cancellation policy and may incur charges, so we recommend confirming your travel dates early.

faqs.q: Can the Black Sea Turkey tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized to your interests. You can add extra nights, combine it with other regions of Turkey, or adjust hotel categories. Contact Magnificent Travel with your dates and group size for a tailored quote.
